title: Joining an acid and alcohol
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: In Fischer esterification, ethanoic acid and ethanol react reversibly to form ethyl ethanoate and water. Removing water favors ester formation; the product retains the carbonyl.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of ethanoic acid under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Ethanoic acid is treated with ethanol, acid catalyst, with water removed. Which major organic product forms after workup? In Fischer esterification, ethanoic acid and ethanol react reversibly to form ethyl ethanoate and water. Removing water favors ester formation; the product retains the carbonyl.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
